The CustomResourceDefinition (CRD) API extends the Kubernetes API by defining new resource types with custom schemas. When a CRD is created, the Kubernetes API server automatically serves and handles storage for the new custom resource type. CRDs enable operators and controllers to manage domain-specific objects using the full Kubernetes API machinery including watch, label selectors, status conditions, and garbage collection.
